scope: Offline-only independent review of the attempt-c integrated v11 methodology and fail-closed evidence validation. No Modal, provider, cloud, CUDA, GPU, commit, or tag operation was performed.

methodology_contract.gpu_requirements: Exactly two visible, distinct NVIDIA A100 GPUs with at least 80 GB each; no silent device or topology substitution.
methodology_contract.topology_comparison_rule: Direct causal timing comparison to frozen v10 is permitted only when exact A100-SXM4 topology is established. A100 PCIe or otherwise non-comparable topology must be labeled and limited to within-run stage comparisons.

guard_a.required: bounded queue, completed rate tracks offered rate, no persistent positive queue drift, p95 TTFT below 2 seconds

guard_b.required: bounded guard backlog and either positive queue slope or completed rate below offered rate; TTFT alone cannot establish overload

overload.required_predicate: positive queue slope and offered rate greater than completed rate for the confirmation window
overload.risk_assessment: At 15 rps with zero completions, the accepted 20-to-30 depth band spans about 0.667 seconds, greater than 2.6 times the 0.25-second confirmation window. A delayed controller that crosses depth 30 is rejected as scientifically invalid instead of being allowed to approach the independent depth-64 emergency abort.

restore_precondition.required_actual_restore_evidence: positive arrivals, completions, emitted tokens, and live queue samples; exact rate and TTFT arithmetic is controller-validated

critical_path_accounting.streaming_overlap_rule: Wall stages that the frozen v11 implementation overlaps are kept fused; canonical StatePassRecords retain operation-level byte attribution without double-counting elapsed wall time.
critical_path_accounting.controller_validation: Stage contiguity, start/end bounds, duration arithmetic, duration conservation, residual-chain arithmetic, phase movement sums, pass counts, and amplification arithmetic are all recomputed fail-closed.

validation_fixes_made: Rejected a 15-rps sanity guard that presents only high TTFT; Guard B now requires positive queue tendency or completed rate below offered rate.
Added exact 9-rps, five-second control-interval evidence and fail-closed validation of arrivals, completions, TTFT, and backlog.
Required the normal integrated trigger to occur at depth 20 through 30, retaining the independent depth-64 emergency abort and at least 34 requests of headroom.
Added post-step live scheduler sampling during the actual GPU1 restore interval without changing the frozen v10 serving implementation or optimized v11 state path.
Required positive GPU0 arrivals, completions, emitted tokens, and live queue observations from RESTORE_TRIGGER through FIRST_RESUMED_TOKEN.
Added contiguous non-overlapping reclamation and restore wall-stage partitions plus separate source-export and rollout-restore canonical movement summaries.
Extended controller validation and mutation tests so missing or arithmetically inconsistent control, restore-activity, critical-path, or phase-movement evidence fails closed.
fail_closed_mutation_tests: zero emitted tokens during the measured restore interval
overlap in the restore critical-path partition
phase movement bytes inconsistent with the integrated total
